name: Four Seasons London at Park Lane
insider_take: Mayfair elegance meets contemporary luxury in the heart of London's most prestigious neighborhood.
whats_special: This Art Deco masterpiece sits directly across from Green Park, offering unparalleled views of Buckingham Palace gardens from select suites. The hotel's Amaranto restaurant boasts one of London's most coveted terraces, while the spa features the city's only hotel hammam with traditional marble heated beds.
pro_tip: Book a Park View room on the higher floors for glimpses of the Changing of the Guard ceremony without the crowds, and request early access to the rooftop terrace for golden hour photography over Hyde Park.
dont_miss: The hotel's proximity to the Royal Academy of Arts and Burlington Arcade puts you steps from world-class exhibitions and Britain's longest covered shopping gallery. Take the 3-minute walk to Fortnum & Mason for their legendary afternoon tea, or explore the hidden mews streets of Mayfair for exclusive galleries and tailors.
pros: Prime Mayfair location with Hyde Park views
Exceptional personalized service and attention to detail
Elegant rooms with premium amenities and technology
cons: Busy Mayfair location may have street noise
